column1: # Everything a Windows AMI build does differently from GitHub's windows-2025 template, in
# one place (ADR-023). One entry per line, tab-separated: skip, the step's id in
# plan-windows-2025.json, the reason. scripts/windows/build-ami.ps1 runs every step not
# listed here, in the template's order, and an entry naming no step stops the build
# before anything runs: it is a pin bump to review, not a line to ignore.
